verdict.seen: A hole is dug with soil flying to a mound, then the pit fills with blue water in a cutaway beside the house.
A water-filled pit with arrows and moist dots moving down through the soil, labelled LEAKING, toward the groundwater.
The water in the pit gets thinner across the frames, with arrows pointing down, and the last frame shows only a thin sheet left.
An empty muddy pit with yellow arrows at the right edge, but the walls stay straight and no mud lumps slump into the pit.
verdict.problem: Show wet mud lumps visibly collapsing from the walls into the pit; the yellow arrows alone do not show a slump.

verdict.seen: The bare pit is lined with a concrete floor and walls that appear across the frames.
The concrete shell fills with blue water, rising from a low level to nearly full.
A white pipe grows from the pool bottom through the soil and up to a grey pump box at the surface.
A teal filter tank pops in beside the pool and pipes link it to the pool and pump.
The finished pool with water, a yellow outline tracing around it, and pipes at its side.
A yellow outline traces around the pump, filter and pipes, growing across the frames.
Arrows show water moving through the pipes toward the filter and pump and back to the pool, with a yellow outline in the first frame.
Arrows in the pool point toward the drain side, with pipes, filter and pump beside it.
A counter beside the pump rises from 0 to 8 while water arrows move in the pool.
The pool water stays blue in all frames; only an ALGAE label appears.
verdict.problem: Tint the water progressively green across the frames instead of relying on the label.

verdict.seen: Rain and brown mud lumps fall into the green water, labelled MURKY.
A chlorine feeder block appears beside the pool, the rain stops and the murky green water becomes clearer.
A white fence, round bushes and trees appear on the grass around the pool, standing on the lawn.
The whole finished pool, house, fence, bushes, trees and circulation system in view as the camera pulls back.
